questions.question: For the patient who was diagnosed with SLE on 1994/2/19, what was his/her anti-Cardiolipin antibody concentration status on 1993/11/12?
questions.evidence: diagnosed with SLE refers to fld008 = 'SLE'; 1994/2/19 refers to fld016 = '1994-02-19'; anti-Cardiolipin refers to aCL fld048; 1993/11/12 refers to Examination fld019 = '1993/11/12'
questions.SQL: SELECT fld007, fld003, fld004 FROM tab01 WHERE fld001 IN (SELECT fld001 FROM tab02 WHERE fld008 = 'SLE' AND fld016 = '1994-02-19') AND fld002 = '1993-11-12'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT `aCL IgA`, `aCL IgG`, `aCL IgM` FROM Examination WHERE ID IN ( SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Description = '1994-02-19' ) AND `Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'

questions.question: Was the patient with the number 57266's uric acid within a normal range?
questions.evidence: uric acid within a normal range refers to fld026 > 8.0 and fld014 = 'M'OR fld026 > 6.5 and fld014 = 'F'
questions.SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN (T1.fld014 = 'F' AND T2.fld026 > 6.5) OR (T1.fld014 = 'M' AND T2.fld026 > 8.0) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld001 = 57266
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CASE WHEN (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5) OR (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA > 8.0) THEN true ELSE false END FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 57266

questions.question: Name the ID and age of patient with two or more laboratory examinations which show their hematoclit level exceeded the normal range.
questions.evidence: age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(fld015)); patient with two or more laboratory examinations refers to COUNT(fld001) > 2; hematoclit level exceeded the normal range refers to fld037 > = 52;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld001 IN (SELECT fld001 FROM tab03 WHERE fld037 >= 52 GROUP BY fld001 HAVING COUNT(fld001) >= 2)
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID IN ( SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE HCT >= 52 GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(ID) >= 2 )

questions.question: For patients with severe degree of thrombosis, list their ID, sex and disease the patient is diagnosed with.
questions.evidence: severe degree of thrombosis refers to fld013 = 2; disease refers to diagnosis;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001, T1.fld014, T1.fld008 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld013 = 2
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

questions.question: How many underage patients were examined during the course of the three-year period from 1990 to 1993?
questions.evidence: underage patients refers to year(fld015) < 18; three-year period from 1990 to 1993 refers to year(fld002) between '1990' and '1993'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld002) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld002) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) < 18
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 18

questions.question: Among the patients with normal anti-SM, how many of them does not have thrombosis?
questions.evidence: normal anti-SM refers to fld055 IN('-', '+-'); fld055 = 'negative' means '-'; fld055 = '0' means '+-'; fld055 = '1' means '+'; does not have thrombosis refers to fld013 = 0;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld055 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.fld013 = 0
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative','0') AND T1.Thrombosis = 0

questions.question: For the patient who was born on 1959/2/18, what is the decrease rate for his/her total cholesterol from November to December in 1981?
questions.evidence: born on 1959/2/18 refers to fld015 = '1959-02-18'; calculation = DIVISION(SUBTRACT(SUM(fld015 = '1959-02-18' and fld019 like '1981-11-%' THEN fld030), SUM(fld015 = '1959-02-18' and fld019 like '1981-12-%' THEN fld030)), SUM(fld015 = '1959-02-18' and fld019 like '1981-12-%' THEN fld030))
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld019 LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN T2.fld030 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld019 LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN T2.fld030 ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld019 LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN T2.fld030 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld015 = '1959-02-18'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1959-02-18'

questions.question: What are the symptoms observed by the youngest patient to ever did a medical examination? Identify their diagnosis.
questions.evidence: The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; symptoms observed refers to the fld012 is not NULL
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld012, T1.fld008 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE NOT T2.fld012 IS NULL ORDER BY T1.fld015 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the patient's diagnosis for those who has lower red blood blood cell? State their ID and age.
questions.evidence: patient's diagnosis refers to Diagnosis; lower red blood cell refers to fld035 < 3.5; age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(fld015));
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld008, T1.fld001, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld035 < 3.5
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis, T1.ID , STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) -STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5

questions.question: What percentage of patients who were born in 1980 and were diagnosed with RA are women?
questions.evidence: born in 1980 refers to YEAR(fld015) = '1980'; 'RA' refers to fld008='RA' ; women refers to fld014 = 'F'; calculation = DIVIDE(SUM(fld014 = 'F'), COUNT(fld014)) * 100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fld014 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(fld001) FROM tab02 WHERE fld008 = 'RA' AND STRFTIME('%Y', fld015) = '1980'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA' AND STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'

questions.question: What is the ratio of male to female patients among all those with abnormal uric acid counts?
questions.evidence: male refers to fld014 = 'M'; female refers to fld014 = 'F'; abnormal uric acid refers to fld026 < = '8.0' where fld014 = 'M', fld026 < = '6.5' where fld014 = 'F'; calculation = DIVIDE(SUM(fld026 <= '8.0' and fld014 = 'M'), SUM(fld026 <= '6.5 and fld014 = 'F'))
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld026 <= 8.0 AND T1.fld014 = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld026 <= 6.5 AND T1.fld014 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.UA <= 8.0 AND T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.UA <= 6.5 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

questions.question: What is the percentage of female patient were born after 1930?
questions.evidence: female refers to fld014 = 'F'; patient who were born after 1930 refers to year(fld015) > '1930'; calculation = DIVIDE(COUNT(fld001) where year(fld015) > '1930' and fld014 = 'F'), (COUNT(fld001) where fld014 = 'F')
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', fld015) > '1930' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM tab02 WHERE fld014 = 'F'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) > '1930' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F'

questions.question: How many patients with a normal Ig A level came to the hospital after 1990/1/1?

questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH > 500

questions.question: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?
questions.evidence: older than 55 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(fld015)) > 55; abnormal prothrombin time (fld039) refers to fld039 > = 14; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld039 > = 14 AND fld014 = 'F'), SUM(fld039 > = 14)) * 100; female refers to fld014 = 'F';
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld039 >= 14 AND T1.fld014 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.fld039 >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) > 55
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55

questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RNP = 'negative' OR T2.RNP = '0' AND T1.Admission = '+'

questions.question: Among the male patients who have a normal level of white blood cells, how many of them have an abnormal fibrinogen level?
questions.evidence: male patients refers to fld014 = 'M'; normal level of white blood cells refers to fld034 > 3.5 and fld034 <9.0; abnormal fibrinogen level refers to fld041 < = 150 or fld041 > = 450; Don't compute repetitive ones.
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld041 <= 150 OR T2.fld041 >= 450 AND T2.fld034 > 3.5 AND T2.fld034 < 9.0 AND T1.fld014 = 'M'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450 AND T2.WBC > 3.5 AND T2.WBC < 9.0 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

questions.question: The oldest SJS patient's medical laboratory work was completed on what date, and what age was the patient when they initially arrived at the hospital?

questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld019, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld017) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld015), T2.fld015 FROM tab03 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld008 = 'SJS' AND NOT T2.fld015 IS NULL ORDER BY T2.fld015 ASC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday),T2.Birthday FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.Birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the patients who were diagnosed with SLE, who is the oldest with normal hemoglobin level. Provide the ID and sex.

questions.question: For all patients with triglyceride (TG) level beyond the normal range, how many are age more than 50 years?

questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG >= 200 AND STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 50
